# sauth_organization_provider (Resource)

The organization_provider records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `organization_id` (String) organization id
- `provider_id` (String) provider id

### Optional

- `email_verify` (Boolean) whether an email registration must verify its address, null for the server default
- `login_mode` (String) login mode
- `oauth_client_id` (String) oauth client id
- `oauth_client_secret` (String, Sensitive) oauth client secret
